about.text: Polish blue cheese similar to Danish blue cheeses. The name derives from Roquefort and suggests that it is a Polish Roquefort, however, it is made with cows' milk.

sources.text: Polish cow-milk blue modelled on Roquefort; pungent, salty; ripening not stated
